control_definitions.paired_truncation: Compare full Egan2Ir2 and tert-butyl-deleted egan2Ir2, with common retained-heavy mapping. Do not substitute the much smaller Hap4Ir2 model as though it were this same truncation.
control_definitions.states: For each dimer examine closed/BS singlet and triplet with stability and natural occupations; classify minimum versus saddle on each claimed state.
control_definitions.distance: For each dimer take its selected equilibrium fragment geometries, then separate rigid fragments by +0.2 and +0.5 angstrom along Ir-Ir, keeping orientation fixed. Compute like-defined interaction and density/orbital descriptors.
control_definitions.twist: At equilibrium distance rotate fragment B 30 degrees about Ir-Ir while keeping both fragments internally rigid; compare orbital mixing and interaction. These interventions need not be minima.
control_definitions.fragments: Use neutral doublets and disclose fragment occupations; if another decomposition is scientifically needed it is a separate calibrated sensitivity, not a hidden replacement.

observable_definition: For neutral doublet fragments A=(ligand)Ir and B=(ligand)Ir: E_int=E_AB-E_A(frozen)-E_B(frozen); E_def=sum[E_fragment(frozen)-E_fragment(relaxed)]; E_assoc=E_int+E_def, kcal/mol. Keep fragment charge/spin, basis/BSSE and relativistic definitions identical. This operational decomposition is not a unique partition of metal–metal versus ligand pi bonding.

required_comparisons.description: True dimers, electronic states and paired truncation
Cross-check orbital, density, bond-index and energy explanations

optional_not_scored: Hap4Ir2 calibration, all oxidation states and large-scale dynamics are optional; licensed EDA is not mandatory.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
